hero.heading: Holmes County School Calendar 2026-2027
hero.mobileDescription: School starts August 12 and ends May 27. Rodeo Holiday is October 2; fall break runs October 29-30.
hero.desktopDescription: Students return January 5 after winter break and March 29 after spring break. Four early-release dates are listed, with report cards and school-specific graduations in the written calendar.

editorialSummary.heading: Rodeo Holiday, a late-October break and a Thursday finish
paragraphs: Holmes County families have two October breaks to plan around in 2026. Friday, October 2, is the Rodeo Holiday, creating a three-day weekend. Later in the month, students leave early October 28 before Fall Break on October 29-30. Classes resume Monday, November 2. Thanksgiving brings a full student week off November 23-27, even though a separate employee holiday entry covers fewer days. Winter break then runs December 21-January 4 for students, with an early-release attendance day on December 18 before the vacation begins.

January 4 is a teacher workday within the student winter break, so children return Tuesday, January 5. Spring break runs March 22-26, 2027, after early release on March 19, and classes resume March 29. Senior families can use the written calendar to plan around four school-specific graduation dates in May. Those ceremonies do not establish a separate last day of classes for seniors. The regular student year ends Thursday, May 27, with early release. For reporting dates, the written calendar lists October 16, January 15 and April 9; confirm the final report’s availability with the school.
highlights: Fall Break is October 29-30, with classes resuming November 2.
Students return from winter break January 5.
The last student day is May 27, with early release.

about.dataSource: The supplied one-page color-coded Holmes District Schools calendar matches the current official download byte for byte. The district’s matching written calendar supplies report-card dates, explicit returns and four named high-school graduations. Both calendars print Board approval on January 27, 2026, and are currently linked from Parent Resources.
about.processing: Read the full extracted text and rendered pages of both official PDFs. Orange marks teacher/student holidays on which 12-month employees work; it does not mean conditional student make-up. Yellow marks all-personnel holidays, blue staff work/pre/post-planning, pink first day/return and green early release. October 9 is an ordinary grading-period ending without early release. Student Thanksgiving covers November 23-27 regardless of separate November 25-27 employee dates. Winter Break for Students is one official December 21-January 4 range; the January 4 employee workday does not add another independent student closure and does not shorten that range. January 5, November 2 and March 29 returns are explicit official entries. Quarter starts are taken from the printed range table; the named returns also retain their grading-start meaning where applicable. One event preserves each early-release/grading/semester/last-day occurrence. Report cards are three exact issue dates from the written calendar, not distribution windows; no final fourth-quarter release or progress-report dates are invented. Graduation milestones are scoped to the four named graduating classes and do not establish attendance endpoints, campus closures, ceremony clocks or venues. Exclude FTE reporting, pre-year employee dates, paid-holiday/employee-group lines, May 28-June 1 post-planning and Memorial Day after the student year. The color PDF’s fourth-quarter range table says March 29-May 28 but its May 27 caption and grid, the written May 27 semester ending and the May 28 post-planning entry establish May 27 as the final student date. The printed 44-day quarter count matches March 29-May 27; including May 28 would make 45 weekdays. No unresolved attendance date is inferred from the inconsistent summary endpoint. The 180 annual attendance figure is derived from printed semesters 84 + 96, not separately printed as an annual total. It reconciles with quarter totals 41/43/52/44 and 207 weekdays minus 27 closures. Both source approval dates are retained; January 28 approval announcement and January 29 PDF metadata are separate from the Board date. The stale 2021-2022 metadata title does not identify the school year. The annual PDFs give no release clocks or weather reserve dates. Current year-specific Poplar Springs bell times are school-scoped, with no invented expiry or districtwide clock. The April 27 district start-times notice says no planned 2026-27 change; no legal conclusion is inferred from it.

Initial DNS/timeouts produced incomplete download files; complete successful downloads were used for all source hashes and review. The full News listing includes the January 28 calendar approval announcement and April 27 start-times statement. No later student-calendar revision or dated attendance adjustment was verified. The dynamic events page did not expose individual event details in the available text; current homepage reminders agree on October 28 early release and October 29 fall break. Confirm school messages for release clocks, ceremonies and weather changes. The Holmes County High 2026-2027 bell page was found, but its image download remained incomplete after an extended approved retry, so no clock was inferred from it or from old 2022-2023 files.
about.disclaimer: This independent reference follows the district’s regular student calendar. Confirm individual school/program schedules, shortened-day transportation, ceremony details and senior obligations directly. School clocks are local Central Time.

faqs.question: When does school start in Holmes County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students begin Wednesday, August 12, 2026. Check your school’s arrival instructions and bus route before the first morning.

faqs.question: Is the last day of school May 27 or May 28?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027, with early release. The calendar’s dated list, color grid and written companion all support May 27. May 28 begins employee post-planning; the May 28 endpoint in the color calendar’s fourth-quarter summary is inconsistent with those entries.

faqs.question: Is there school on the Rodeo Holiday?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, October 2, 2026, is the Rodeo Holiday for students. With the weekend, students have October 2-4 off and are scheduled to return Monday, October 5.

faqs.question: When is fall break, and when do classes resume?
faqs.answer: Fall break is Thursday and Friday, October 29-30, 2026. Including the weekend, the continuous time off is October 29-November 1. The written calendar lists Monday, November 2, as the return. Wednesday, October 28, is an early-release school day.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students are off November 23-27, 2026. Including both weekends, the break lasts November 21-29, with classes scheduled to resume Monday, November 30. The separate November 25-27 employee holiday entry does not shorten the student break.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and do students return on January 4?
faqs.answer: The student Christmas/Winter Break runs December 21, 2026-January 4, 2027. January 4 is a teacher workday while students remain on break. Students return Tuesday, January 5. Including weekends, the continuous time off is December 19-January 4.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs March 22-26, 2027. With both weekends, students have March 20-28 away from regular classes. Classes resume Monday, March 29. Friday, March 19, is an early-release school day.

faqs.question: Are students off on Good Friday or Easter Monday?
faqs.answer: Good Friday, March 26, 2027, falls within the listed spring break. Monday, March 29, is explicitly listed as Classes Resume, so there is no additional Easter Monday holiday on this calendar.

faqs.question: Which dates have early release?
faqs.answer: The four dates are October 28 and December 18, 2026, and March 19 and May 27, 2027. Students attend on those dates and leave early. December 18 ends the first semester, March 19 ends the third quarter, and May 27 is the final student day.

faqs.question: What time do students leave on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The district calendars identify the four early-release dates without giving dismissal times. Use your school’s specific release notice for pickup, buses and childcare; regular bell times alone do not establish a shortened-day dismissal time.

faqs.question: When are report cards issued?
faqs.answer: The written calendar lists Friday, October 16, 2026; Friday, January 15, 2027; and Friday, April 9, 2027. It does not give a final fourth-quarter report-card date. Check your school’s end-of-year instructions for the final report.

faqs.question: When do the quarters and semesters end?
faqs.answer: The quarters end October 9 and December 18, 2026, and March 19 and May 27, 2027. The first semester ends December 18 and the second ends May 27. October 9 is a grading milestone without a listed early release; the other three endings have early release.

faqs.question: How many student days are scheduled in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The published semester totals are 84 and 96 days, which add up to 180 student days. The quarter totals are 41, 43, 52 and 44. The annual figure is a sum of published subtotals, and it also agrees with a weekday count using the listed student holidays. Early-release dates still count as attendance days.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day or Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: Students are off Monday, September 7, 2026, for Labor Day. Wednesday, November 11, is a scheduled school day under the published calendar; it is not marked as a student holiday.

faqs.question: Are Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Presidents Day student holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students have no classes on Monday, January 18, 2027, or Monday, February 15. Both dates are listed as holidays.

faqs.question: When are the 2027 high school graduations?
faqs.answer: The written calendar lists Ponce de Leon High on May 14, Poplar Springs High on May 17, Bethlehem High on May 18 and Holmes County High on May 20. Confirm ceremony times and venues with the relevant school.

faqs.question: Does a graduation date tell seniors when their classes end?
faqs.answer: The calendar gives ceremony dates but no separate senior last-attendance dates or exam-release rules. Confirm senior obligations directly with the high school. A graduation entry does not change the regular district calendar for other students.

faqs.question: What are Poplar Springs School’s regular hours?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 bell schedule lists an 8:00 a.m. tardy bell and 2:38 p.m. dismissal for all students. The entry gate opens and breakfast begins at 7:30 a.m., with the first bell at 7:55 a.m. These are local Central Time hours for Poplar Springs, not a districtwide schedule.

faqs.question: Are school start times changing for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The superintendent’s April 27, 2026, announcement says the district plans to keep its traditional start times for 2026-2027. Use each school’s current bell schedule for the exact arrival and dismissal times; schools do not all share one clock schedule.

faqs.question: Does the calendar list hurricane make-up days?
faqs.answer: Neither approved calendar designates specific hurricane make-up dates or an activation order. Check district announcements and school messages after a weather closure for any changes to breaks, early release or the last student day.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official calendar and check for changes?
faqs.answer: On the district Parent Resources page, look under Helpful Files for the 2026-27 color-coded and written calendars, both approved January 27, 2026. The written version includes report-card and graduation dates. Check district news, the online calendar and school messages for later changes.
